name: powertoys shortcuts
description: Compact Microsoft PowerToys shortcut bar for Color Picker, Text Extractor, Always on Top, Screen Ruler, and Crop and Lock.
author: FuncOverlay

settingsSchema.label: PowerToys Executable Path
settingsSchema.description: Path to PowerToys.exe used if PowerToys is not already running (auto-detected if installed elsewhere).

settingsSchema.label: Crop and Lock Mode
settingsSchema.description: Which Crop and Lock shortcut to trigger: screenshot, thumbnail, or reparent.

settingsSchema.label: Auto-Launch PowerToys If Closed
settingsSchema.description: Start PowerToys automatically before triggering a tool if PowerToys is not running.

settingsSchema.label: Additional Sleep
settingsSchema.description: Extra wait (ms) after overlay fade before sending hotkey. Only applies to Always on Top (AOT) and Crop and Lock (CAL). Default: 100 ms.
